note: Frozen conformance fixtures. Solidity, Rust and TypeScript must reproduce every expected value exactly. A one-wei disagreement is a failure.

scenarios.description: No collateral, no debt. Every derived value is zero and health is unbounded.
1,000 USTBx at $1. Haircuts bind; the exit curve does not at this size.
Same position carrying $500 of debt at index 1.0. Comfortably inside the borrow limit.
Debt exceeds the initial-LTV limit but not maintenance. New risk is blocked, the position is not yet in trouble.
Maintenance breached but liquidation not yet. Reduce-only, health just below 1.0. Limits here are 833.11 / 882.11 / 911.52, so 900 sits in the reduce-only band.
Liquidation threshold breached. Margin call.
Price is one second past its maximum age. Capacity is frozen at zero even though the recognised value still computes.
Evidence is older than the policy allows. Same outcome: no new risk.
Two extraction paths disagreed. The asset keeps its value but the account cannot take on new risk while the conflict is open.
Issuer-level suspension. Existing exposure remains measurable; new risk is blocked.
5,000 NVDAx at $120 is $600,000 of market value, into the 92% tier. The exit curve is now the binding constraint rather than the haircut stack.
10,000 NVDAx is $1.2m, past the final threshold. The worst tier applies.
A portfolio that is 60%-capped on the equity leg. The cap is computed against the uncapped total, so it bites before the limits are summed.
Realistic two-asset portfolio carrying debt. Exercises ordered summation across differing LTVs and decimals.
An in-flight execution has reserved $2,000. Available borrowing drops by exactly that amount even though debt has not changed.
Borrow index has grown to 1.0537. Debt is reconstructed from scaled principal and rounds up.
The L2 sequencer is down. Prices exist but cannot be arbitraged, so they are not prices we lend against.
The sequencer restarted 600 seconds ago, inside the 3,600-second grace period.
A healthy account that a guardian has placed in reduce-only. The override is a floor: it restricts and cannot be undone by favourable inputs.
One wei of a token. Every downstream value truncates to zero without underflowing.
Redemption floor set below the haircut mark and the exit value, so it becomes the binding term of the min().
A zero answer is not a price. The oracle is invalid and capacity is zero.
A 6-decimal money-market token at a non-round price. Market value, the haircut chain and every limit carry a remainder, so rounding direction is observable.
An 8-decimal commodity token, matching Chainlink's native answer scale, with a redemption floor that does not divide evenly.
18, 8 and 6 decimal assets in one portfolio. Exercises ordered summation across differing scales where each leg truncates independently.
A 3,333 bps concentration cap against an uncapped total that does not divide by 10,000, so the cap itself carries a remainder.
Scaled principal and an index chosen so debt reconstruction has a remainder. Pins the round-up rule in accounting.md 3.1: rounding down here would under-state what is owed.
Five distinct haircuts on a value with a remainder at every step. Swapping any adjacent pair changes the truncated result, which is what makes the frozen order load-bearing.
